5. **Difference section**: title, description, all differences (icon, title, description), any CTAs
6. **Services/Products section**: title, description, all items (icon, title, description, image), any CTAs
7. **FAQ section**: title, description, all Q&A pairs (question, answer)
8. **Footer CTA**: headline, description, buttonText, href, secondaryButton, taglines
9. **Navigation**: links, serviceLinks, companyLinks, cta

```

  backgroundImage: "..."
  logo: "..."
```
